scope: shared native policy with Linux normal/MESH adapters, capability host, root service and UID-bound IPC; memory-only manager recovery, authorized user client, root/user signed-floor synchronization and GTK Auto; locally tested, installed acceptance and Windows product integration remain open

policy_ipc.scope: private parent/child pipes, not GUI/service authorization

linux_mesh_candidate.scope: real materials/native/TUN adapter with no recovery loop; called by the native-policy root host, not yet installed-accepted

linux_guard.scope: owned nftables traffic containment across real host attempts; installed VPN acceptance remains open

linux_host.scope: capabilities, physical network fingerprint and existing normal/MESH adapters; native controller tests use synthetic OS operations

linux_service.scope: UID/generation-bound commands, systemd-held credentials, signed catalog readback and authorized GUI launch; Auto requires the verified separate capability marker; not installed-accepted

host_requirements: Install and verify fail-closed ownership before configuration and attempts
Configure returns only real supported and authorized normal capabilities; transient refresh/cache semantics stay in host
Open returns only after platform TUN/routes/DNS and health are verified, never just process spawn
CloseCandidate blocks user traffic before cleanup and never releases the guard
Release restores only owned resources after explicit Disconnect
Only privileged service/broker sockets may use underlying-network bypass
Use generation from the owning session for every late callback; no cross-session cleanup
Cooperate with cancellation/deadlines; use existing platform cleanup timeout (0 < timeout <= 60s)
desktop_adaptations: Serialized transitions and concurrent cancellation; stale generation rejection
Context deadlines supplement host monotonic deadlines; no per-candidate goroutine
128 sanitized events with dropped-event counter and first reason
Go TLS validation errors remain terminal even inside network-error wrappers
Cleanup watchdog supplied by platform, not a recovery timer change
not_implemented: Linux authorized GUI launch/activation and root/user signed-floor synchronization
Windows broker host and authenticated IPC
